name: What should I prepare before our first meeting about a new construction project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before our first meeting about a new construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our first meeting, gathering any existing architectural plans, inspirational images, or a list of desired features is helpful. Also, having a general idea of your budget and timeline expectations can inform our discussion. This initial information allows us to understand your vision and provide more accurate guidance specific to your project goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before our meeting, prepare architectural plans, inspiration, desired features, and a general idea of your budget and timeline expectations.
